extracted.intended_audience: people (mostly amateurs) wishing to enter Laugh Factory-run comedy contests
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and submission criteria for entering Laugh Factory contests (e.g., Funniest Average Joe, Laugh Bowl, Funniest Person in the World). Covers eligibility, how to enter, selection method, prize conditions, IP/licensing, and legal terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility (age and employee exclusions)
rubrics_metrics.description: This Campaign is open only to those who sign up here and who are 16 as of the date of entry. Employees of Laugh Factory Inc., its affiliates, subsidiaries, advertising and promotion agencies, and suppliers, and immediate family members and/or those living in the same household of Employees are not eligible to participate. The Campaign is subject to all applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations. Void where prohibited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants must be at least 16 at time of entry; employees, their immediate family, and household members are ineligible. Compliance with law is required; if local law prohibits participation the entrant is excluded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement to Rules (acceptance of organizer decisions)
rubrics_metrics.description: By participating, the Contestant ('You') agree to be fully unconditionally bound by these Rules, and You represent and warrant that You meet the eligibility requirements. In addition, You agree to accept the decisions of Laugh Factory Inc. as final and binding as it relates to the content of this Campaign.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entering constitutes acceptance of all official rules and finality of organizer decisions regarding the campaign and content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Campaign Period (timing of entries)
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries will be accepted online starting on [TBD] and ending [TBD]. All online entries must be received by [TBD].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only entries submitted within the published campaign period (and received by any stated deadlines) are eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to Enter (submission completeness and single-entry rules)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Campaign must be entered by submitting an entry using the online form provided here. The entry must fulfill all Campaign requirements, as specified, to be eligible to win a prize. Entries that are incomplete or do not adhere to the rules or specifications may be disqualified at the sole discretion of Laugh Factory Inc. You must provide the information requested. You may not enter more times than indicated by using multiple email addresses, identities, or devices in an attempt to circumvent the rules. If You use fraudulent methods or otherwise attempt to circumvent the rules, your submission may be removed from eligibility at the sole discretion of Laugh Factory Inc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit via the specified online form only; provide all requested info; do not submit multiple entries by using multiple emails/IDs/devices; incomplete or rule-violating entries can be disqualified for any reason at organizer's sole discretion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contestant type restriction (non-comedian requirement for some contests)
rubrics_metrics.description: This competition is for those who have a gift for making people laugh but have never taken the stage. Everyone is welcome except comedians. We don’t care if you’re a janitor, teacher, or an astronaut - if you remind the world how to laugh again you can win $10,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certain contests (e.g., Funniest Average Joe) explicitly exclude professional/working comedians; target entrants are amateurs who have not previously performed on stage as comedians.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection mechanism (community vote / regional judging)
rubrics_metrics.description: Winner will be selected by community vote under the supervision of Laugh Factory Inc. (Laugh Bowl: judged based on submissions from other schools in the region). Contestants will be whittled down from a group of 100 for the title of the Funniest Average Joe in the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Winners are determined by community voting (and in some contests by regional school submissions). Selection may involve multiple elimination rounds and regional comparisons as described per contest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Winner notification and claiming requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Winner will be notified by emails within five (5) days following selection of Winner. If Winner cannot be contacted, is ineligible, fails to claim the prize within 14 days from the time award notification was sent, or fails to timely return a completed and executed declaration and release as required, the prize may be forfeited and an alternate Winner selected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Winners must provide contactable, accurate information, respond within stated timeframes, and return required paperwork to claim prize; failure to comply can lead to forfeiture and selection of an alternate winner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prize terms (amount, nontransferability, taxes, publicity rights)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Winner(s) of the Campaign (the 'Winner') will receive $10,000. Actual/appraised value may differ at time of prize award. The specifics of the prize shall be solely determined by Laugh Factory Inc. No cash or other prize substitution shall be permitted except at Laugh Factory Inc. discretion. The prize is nontransferable. Any and all prize-related expenses, including without limitation any and all federal, state, and/or local taxes, shall be the sole responsibility of Winner. No substitution of prize or transfer/assignment of prize to others or request for the cash equivalent by Winner is permitted. Acceptance of prize constitutes permission for Laugh Factory Inc. to use Winner’s name, likeness, and entry for purposes of advertising and trade without further compensation unless prohibited by law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prize is fixed as described, nontransferable, and winner bears taxes/expenses. Acceptance grants organizer publicity rights without further payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Odds of winning
rubrics_metrics.description: The odds of winning depend on the number of eligible entries received.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No guaranteed odds; probability is a function of total eligible entrant pool.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rights granted by entrant (license and publicity)
rubrics_metrics.description: By entering this content (e.g., photo, video, text, etc.), You understand and agree that Laugh Factory Inc. and anyone acting on behalf of Laugh Factory Inc., and Laugh Factory Inc.’s licensees, successors, and assigns, shall have the right, where permitted by law, to print, publish, broadcast, distribute, and use in any media now known or hereafter developed, in perpetuity and throughout the World, without limitation, your entry, name, portrait, picture, voice, likeness, image, statements about the Campaign, and biographical information for news, publicity, information, trade, advertising, public relations, and promotional purposes. without any further compensation, notice, review, or consent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants grant a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free license for organizer and assigns to use their entry and likeness for promotional and other purposes without further compensation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intellectual property representation and indemnity
rubrics_metrics.description: By entering this content, You represent and warrant that your entry is an original work of authorship, and does not violate any third party’s proprietary or intellectual property rights. If your entry infringes upon the intellectual property right of another, You will be disqualified at the sole discretion of Laugh Factory Inc. If the content of your entry is claimed to constitute infringement of any proprietary or intellectual proprietary rights of any third party, You shall, at your sole expense, defend or settle against such claims. You shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Laugh Factory Inc. from and against any suit, proceeding, claims, liability, loss, damage, costs or expense, which Laugh Factory Inc. incur, suffer, or be required to pay arising out of such infringement or suspected infringement of any third party’s right.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrant must assure originality and freedom from third‑party claims; organizer may disqualify infringing entries; entrant is responsible for defending and indemnifying the organizer against IP claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizer's right to cancel, modify, or disqualify
rubrics_metrics.description: Laugh Factory Inc. reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to cancel, terminate, modify or suspend the Campaign should virus, bug, non-authorized human intervention, fraud, or other cause beyond Laugh Factory Inc.’s control corrupt or affect the administration, security, fairness, or proper conduct of the Campaign. In such case, Laugh Factory Inc. may select the Winner from all eligible entries received prior to and/or after (if appropriate) the action taken by Laugh Factory Inc. Laugh Factory Inc. reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to disqualify any individual who tampers or attempts to tamper with the entry process or the operation of the Campaign or website or violates these Terms & Conditions. Laugh Factory Inc. has the right, in its sole discretion, to maintain the integrity of the Campaign, to void votes for any reason, including, but not limited to: multiple entries from the same user from different IP addresses; multiple entries from the same computer in excess of that allowed by Campaign rules; or the use of bots, macros, scripts, or other technical means for entering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizer may take broad unilateral action to preserve fairness and integrity, including voiding votes, disqualifying entrants for tampering or automated entry, and selecting alternative winners if necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibited and punishable conduct (tampering and abuse)
rubrics_metrics.description: Any attempt by an entrant to deliberately damage any website or undermine the legitimate operation of the Campaign may be a violation of criminal and civil laws. Should such an attempt be made, Laugh Factory Inc. reserves the right to seek damages to the fullest extent permitted by law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliberate attacks on the website or systems or attempts to manipulate results may lead to civil/criminal liability and organizer legal action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation of Liability and release
rubrics_metrics.description: By entering, You agree to release and hold harmless Laugh Factory Inc. and its subsidiaries, affiliates, advertising and promotion agencies, partners, representatives, agents, successors, assigns, employees, officers, and directors from any liability, illness, injury, death, loss, litigation, claim, or damage that may occur, directly or indirectly, whether caused by negligence or not, from: (i) such entrant’s participation in the Campaign and/or his/her acceptance, possession, use, or misuse of any prize or any portion thereof; (ii) technical failures of any kind, including but not limited to the malfunction of any computer, cable, network, hardware, or software, or other mechanical equipment; (iii) the unavailability or inaccessibility of any transmissions, telephone, or Internet service; (iv) unauthorized human intervention in any part of the entry process or the Promotion; (v) electronic or human error in the administration of the Promotion or the processing of entries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants waive many claims against the organizer related to participation, prize use, technical failures, human/technical errors, and unauthorized interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dispute resolution and governing law
rubrics_metrics.description: This campaign is governed by the laws of the united states of America and California without respect to conflict of law doctrines. As a condition of participating in this Campaign, participant agrees that any and all disputes that cannot be resolved between the parties, and causes of action arising out of or connected with this Campaign, shall be resolved individually, without resort to any form of class action, exclusively before a court located in California having jurisdiction. Further, in any such dispute, under no circumstances shall participant be permitted to obtain awards for, and hereby waives all rights to, punitive, incidental, or consequential damages, including reasonable attorney’s fees, other than participant’s actual out-of-pocket expenses (i.e. costs associated with entering this Campaign). Participant further waives all rights to have damages multiplied or increased.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participants consent to California law and courts, waive rights to class actions and many forms of damages, and limit recoverable costs to actual out-of-pocket expenses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy policy notice for submitted information
rubrics_metrics.description: Information submitted with an entry is subject to the Privacy Policy stated on the Laugh Factory Inc. website. To read the Privacy Policy, [privacy policy URL] click here. Note: a privacy policy is optional, but may be required when running a promotion on the web when using third party platforms or when using features from social channels. Including this information makes it clear to your users how you are going to use their information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants' submission data will be handled under the organizer's privacy policy; contest operators should include privacy policy details when running online promotions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contest-specific scope and audience guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Funniest Average Joe: This competition is for those who have a gift for making people laugh but have never taken the stage. Laugh Bowl: comedy’s March Madness for college and high school stand-up comedy; tailor-made for jocks, nerds, goths, or artists who can make people laugh no matter the time, place, or grade point average. Funniest Person in the World: Enter this contest to represent your country and bring joy with your humor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each named contest has an intended entrant profile and framing (amateurs, students, international representatives). Use the contest description to determine eligibility and target audience.
